# Relevance Assessment

This folder contains documentation on how clinical quality indicators are evaluated for their applicability to specific patient populations within the corpus. The available evidence is currently limited to a single institutional assessment, in which Regionshospital Nordjylland determined that a specific indicator is primarily relevant for a distinct subgroup of "4X patients." No broader chronological context or additional multi-institutional evaluations are present in the current data.

## Pages

- [[relevance-assessment|Relevance Assessment]] — Details the evaluation of clinical quality indicators for specific patient groups, highlighting Regionshospital Nordjylland's conclusion regarding Indikator 3 and "4X patients."
